records.context: Names are split into tokens (at ``_ - . space``, and failing that into digit and letter runs); the tokens that vary are found; one is tried as the image data channel -- or, when the user assigned image data channels, the tokens that only follow the image data channel are set aside -- and the rest must identify a set that holds exactly one image per image data channel. Each candidate is checked with :func:`check_sets` before it is returned. spaCR's own Yokogawa pattern is tried first and returned when it passes; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` is tried last. Of the other candidates that pass, the one with the fewest image data channels is returned, the earliest on a tie, because a regex that reads each name as its own image data channel in a single set also passes the check.
records.label: spacr.channel_sorting.infer_regex#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Names are split into tokens (at ``_ - . space``, and failing that into digit and letter runs); the tokens that vary are found; one is tried as the channel -- or, when the user assigned channels, the tokens that only follow the channel are set aside -- and the rest must identify a set that holds exactly one image per channel. Each candidate is checked with :func:`check_sets` before it is returned. spaCR's own Yokogawa pattern is tried first and returned when it passes; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` is tried last. Of the other candidates that pass, the one with the fewest channels is returned, the earliest on a tie, because a regex that reads each name as its own channel in a single set also passes the check.
records.translation: Namnen delas upp i token (vid ``_ - . space``, och om det inte går i följder av siffror och bokstäver); de token som varierar hittas; en provas som kanal -- eller, när användaren har tilldelat kanaler, läggs de token som bara följer kanalen åt sidan -- och resten måste identifiera en mängd som innehåller exakt en bild per kanal. Varje kandidat kontrolleras med :func:`check_sets` innan den returneras. spaCR:s eget Yokogawa-mönster provas först och returneras när det klarar kontrollen; :func:`spacr.regex_infer.propose` provas sist. Av de övriga kandidater som klarar kontrollen returneras den med minst antal kanaler, den tidigaste vid lika, eftersom ett reguljärt uttryck som läser varje namn som sin egen kanal i en enda mängd också klarar kontrollen.

records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge convention, because the metrics are its: a label stack where the label is the track id, so an object keeps its label for as long as it is the same object, plus an optional lineage mapping each label to its parent label. A division is therefore two new labels whose parent is the old one; a tracker that cannot express divisions passes no lineage and is charged for the two missing parent edges, as the plain stitcher is.
records.translation: Konventionen från Cell Tracking Challenge, eftersom måtten är dess: en etikettstack där etiketten är spår-id:t, så att ett objekt behåller sin etikett så länge det är samma objekt, plus en valfri härstamning som kopplar varje etikett till dess föräldraetikett. records.context: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_qc#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.translation: Timeflows-planen vilar på ett påstående om träningsdata: ett objekt behåller samma etikett i varje bildruta där det förekommer. Ett tidsflödeshuvud tränas att peka från en pixel i ett objekt i bildruta ``t`` mot det objektets centrum i bildruta ``t+1``, och det enda som säger vilket objekt i ``t+1`` som är samma objekt är etiketten. Om annoteringen återanvänder en etikett efter att dess objekt dött eller lämnat fältet tränas modellen att peka mot en orelaterad cell, och ingen senare poäng fångar det -- den undanhållna kontrollen blandar samma felaktiga etiketter och håller med sig själv.
